title: Standard MURDLE — Vault Breach
subtitle: Standard mode: 5 suspects, 5 weapons, 5 locations
storyHtml:
A confidential solution design disappeared from the Dynavics Solution Vault. The access log identifies five possible suspects and five unusual items.

Determine the suspect, item, and location connected to the breach.

clues.text: Zara was in the Solution Vault.
The Passcode was used in the Solution Vault.
Milo carried the Headset in the AI Studio.
Erin worked in the Project Room.
The Notebook was in the Project Room.
The Tablet was in the Demo Suite.
The USB Key was not in the Support Hub.
The Scanner was found in the Support Hub.
